title: Build AI agents with context engineering for autonomous execution
description:
High impact AI agents require precision search. While models get the glory, context engineering is the real work.This live demo shows how you can ship context driven agents using Elastic Agent Builder on Azure. Master context engineering with Elasticsearch hybrid search via Index Search and ES|QL. Use Elastic Workflows to move from Q&A to autonomous action and leverage built-in MCP to connect to the Microsoft ecosystem. Deploy a production ready reference implementation today.

Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.
